posts.text: Deeply pained by the loss of lives in the accident in Dhar, Madhya Pradesh. My thoughts are with the bereaved families. Praying for the speedy recovery of the injured.
posts.caption: Deeply pained by the loss of lives in the accident in Dhar, Madhya Pradesh. My thoughts are with the bereaved families. Praying for the speedy recovery of the injured.

posts.text: Governor of Haryana, Prof. Ashim Kumar Ghosh, met Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi today. PM also wished for the speedy recovery of Shri Ajay Rai.
posts.caption: Governor of Haryana, Prof. Ashim Kumar Ghosh, met Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi today. PM also wished for the speedy recovery of Shri Ajay Rai.

posts.text: Addressed the Lok Sabha on reservation, delimitation, and representation. Under PM @narendramodi's leadership, we remain fully committed to social justice and the constitutional rights of every citizen.
posts.caption: Addressed the Lok Sabha on reservation, delimitation, and representation. Under PM @narendramodi's leadership, we remain fully committed to social justice and the constitutional rights of every citizen.

posts.text: India's national interests must never be compromised. We will continue to raise tough questions in Parliament — that is our constitutional duty as the Opposition.
posts.caption: India's national interests must never be compromised. We will continue to raise tough questions in Parliament — that is our constitutional duty as the Opposition.

posts.text: Today, 223 students were honoured — only 85 boys and 138 girls. Girls are working harder and securing higher marks. UP will also recruit 1 lakh youth in police over the next two years. Crime under the guise of friendship will not be tolerated.
posts.caption: Today, 223 students were honoured — only 85 boys and 138 girls. Girls are working harder and securing higher marks. UP will also recruit 1 lakh youth in police over the next two years. Crime under the guise of friendship will not be tolerated.

posts.text: The people of Delhi deserve better governance and transparency. AAP will continue to fight for every citizen's right to quality education, healthcare, and clean water.
posts.caption: The people of Delhi deserve better governance and transparency. AAP will continue to fight for every citizen's right to quality education, healthcare, and clean water.

posts.text: India's relationship with the US is of immense importance. It is built on substance, not symbolism. We advocate de-escalation and return to dialogue and diplomacy in West Asia. Safety of Indian nationals remains our topmost priority.
posts.caption: India's relationship with the US is of immense importance. It is built on substance, not symbolism. We advocate de-escalation and return to dialogue and diplomacy in West Asia. Safety of Indian nationals remains our topmost priority.

posts.text: Budget 2026 reflects our commitment to continuity, certainty, and predictability. Structural reforms, productivity gains, and technology adoption will drive employment and expansion. ₹12.2 lakh crore in capital expenditure to accelerate infrastructure.
posts.caption: Budget 2026 reflects our commitment to continuity, certainty, and predictability. Structural reforms, productivity gains, and technology adoption will drive employment and expansion. ₹12.2 lakh crore in capital expenditure to accelerate infrastructure.

posts.text: Met 17 of India's most compelling startup founders, most building at the frontiers of deep tech. The next India will not be built in silos — it will be built at the intersection of founders, infrastructure, capital, energy, logistics, AI, space and talent. Founders build companies. Ecosystems build nations.
posts.caption: Met 17 of India's most compelling startup founders, most building at the frontiers of deep tech. The next India will not be built in silos — it will be built at the intersection of founders, infrastructure, capital, energy, logistics, AI, space and talent. Founders build companies. Ecosystems build nations.

posts.text: India's digital transformation is accelerating. With Jio's AI-powered platforms and nationwide connectivity, we are building the foundation for a truly digital India — empowering every citizen with world-class technology.
posts.caption: India's digital transformation is accelerating. With Jio's AI-powered platforms and nationwide connectivity, we are building the foundation for a truly digital India — empowering every citizen with world-class technology.

posts.text: The legacy of the Tata Group lives on — serving the nation, investing in innovation, and upholding values that put people first. India's best days are ahead.
posts.caption: The legacy of the Tata Group lives on — serving the nation, investing in innovation, and upholding values that put people first. India's best days are ahead.

posts.text: Administered the oath of office to 5 new Supreme Court judges today. India's judiciary continues to strengthen, upholding the rule of law and constitutional values for all citizens.
posts.caption: Administered the oath of office to 5 new Supreme Court judges today. India's judiciary continues to strengthen, upholding the rule of law and constitutional values for all citizens.

posts.text: Talks are continuing, at a rapid pace, with the Islamic Republic of Iran. Had a very productive call with Bibi — no troops going to Beirut. Hezbollah agreed all shooting will stop. Just sit back and relax, it will all work out well in the end — It always does!
posts.caption: Talks are continuing, at a rapid pace, with the Islamic Republic of Iran. Had a very productive call with Bibi — no troops going to Beirut. Hezbollah agreed all shooting will stop. Just sit back and relax, it will all work out well in the end — It always does!

posts.text: AI is the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But we won't adopt it at scale unless the public is reassured it is safe. The labs can't just mark their own homework — government needs the ability to test these models itself. There's one area where we're teaching America a lesson on AI safety.
posts.caption: AI is the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But we won't adopt it at scale unless the public is reassured it is safe. The labs can't just mark their own homework — government needs the ability to test these models itself. There's one area where we're teaching America a lesson on AI safety.

posts.text: This is obviously 100% fake, originally fabricated by a leftist blogger with mental health issues. I'm a Cavs fan. Our team got smoked. My wife and I watched the game in disbelief, then peaced out right after the buzzer. Exhibit A of how toxic politics works.
posts.caption: This is obviously 100% fake, originally fabricated by a leftist blogger with mental health issues. I'm a Cavs fan. Our team got smoked. My wife and I watched the game in disbelief, then peaced out right after the buzzer. Exhibit A of how toxic politics works.

posts.text: Proud to represent the best of the Indian-American community in this administration. Our heritage of hard work, family values, and service to this great nation continues to inspire.
posts.caption: Proud to represent the best of the Indian-American community in this administration. Our heritage of hard work, family values, and service to this great nation continues to inspire.

posts.text: Operation Spring Cleaning is the latest success story in this FBI's full-throttle mission to surge resources across the country, crushing violent crime and saving American lives. 1,139 arrests, 984 firearms seized, 615 indictments. These surges truly save lives.
posts.caption: Operation Spring Cleaning is the latest success story in this FBI's full-throttle mission to surge resources across the country, crushing violent crime and saving American lives. 1,139 arrests, 984 firearms seized, 615 indictments. These surges truly save lives.

posts.text: The intersection of AI and policy is where the next decade gets decided. Excited to be working on making America the global leader in AI innovation while keeping the ecosystem open and competitive.
posts.caption: The intersection of AI and policy is where the next decade gets decided. Excited to be working on making America the global leader in AI innovation while keeping the ecosystem open and competitive.

posts.text: The World Bank must be fit for purpose in this era of converging crises — climate, conflict, and AI disruption. We're accelerating our lending reform and bringing in private capital at scale to meet the moment.
posts.caption: The World Bank must be fit for purpose in this era of converging crises — climate, conflict, and AI disruption. We're accelerating our lending reform and bringing in private capital at scale to meet the moment.

posts.text: Trump's NATO remarks are insulting and frankly, appalling. If I had misspoken in that way, I would certainly apologise. It is long past time for Europe to strengthen its hard power — and Britain must play a leading role.
posts.caption: Trump's NATO remarks are insulting and frankly, appalling. If I had misspoken in that way, I would certainly apologise. It is long past time for Europe to strengthen its hard power — and Britain must play a leading role.

posts.text: Australia stands with our allies in calling for de-escalation in the Middle East. We remain committed to a rules-based international order and the safety of all Australians abroad.
posts.caption: Australia stands with our allies in calling for de-escalation in the Middle East. We remain committed to a rules-based international order and the safety of all Australians abroad.

posts.text: The French Navy boarded an oil tanker sailing from Russia under a false flag. It is unacceptable for ships to circumvent international sanctions and finance the war Russia has been waging against Ukraine. €93 billion in investment pledges at Choose France — we are bridging the AI gap in Europe.
posts.caption: The French Navy boarded an oil tanker sailing from Russia under a false flag. It is unacceptable for ships to circumvent international sanctions and finance the war Russia has been waging against Ukraine. €93 billion in investment pledges at Choose France — we are bridging the AI gap in Europe.

posts.text: Dubai continues to lead the way in innovation, AI adoption, and global connectivity. Our vision is clear — to build a city that serves as a bridge between East and West, powered by technology and human ambition.
posts.caption: Dubai continues to lead the way in innovation, AI adoption, and global connectivity. Our vision is clear — to build a city that serves as a bridge between East and West, powered by technology and human ambition.

posts.text: The amount of compute being deployed for AI training right now is insane. xAI's Colossus cluster is running at full capacity. We're pushing toward models that truly understand the physical world — not just text. The next 12 months will blow people's minds.
posts.caption: The amount of compute being deployed for AI training right now is insane. xAI's Colossus cluster is running at full capacity. We're pushing toward models that truly understand the physical world — not just text. The next 12 months will blow people's minds.

posts.text: I think a reasonable company should try to help the people that use its services. At Meta, we continue investing in AI that's open and accessible — Llama models are powering innovation across the globe.
posts.caption: I think a reasonable company should try to help the people that use its services. At Meta, we continue investing in AI that's open and accessible — Llama models are powering innovation across the globe.

posts.text: AI is the biggest platform shift of our lifetimes. We are on the cusp of hyperprogress and new discoveries that can help emerging economies leapfrog legacy gaps. Google is establishing a full-stack AI hub in Vizag — part of our $15 billion infrastructure investment in India.
posts.caption: AI is the biggest platform shift of our lifetimes. We are on the cusp of hyperprogress and new discoveries that can help emerging economies leapfrog legacy gaps. Google is establishing a full-stack AI hub in Vizag — part of our $15 billion infrastructure investment in India.

posts.text: Today at Microsoft Build 2026, we're showing developers how to build for the era of AI. We've moved past discovery into widespread diffusion. The opportunities we're creating for developers in this era are immense — this is just the beginning.
posts.caption: Today at Microsoft Build 2026, we're showing developers how to build for the era of AI. We've moved past discovery into widespread diffusion. The opportunities we're creating for developers in this era are immense — this is just the beginning.

posts.text: The OpenAI Foundation is doing a lot of wonderful things. Helping society become resilient to AI is going to be incredibly important. Much more to come here! There is a race to deliver the best technology — going public is a financing event, not what we're focused on.
posts.caption: The OpenAI Foundation is doing a lot of wonderful things. Helping society become resilient to AI is going to be incredibly important. Much more to come here! There is a race to deliver the best technology — going public is a financing event, not what we're focused on.

posts.text: The collaboration with Google is going well. We are happy with where things are. WWDC 2026 kicks off June 8 — all systems glow. We're excited to share what's next across iOS 27, macOS, and the future of Siri.
posts.caption: The collaboration with Google is going well. We are happy with where things are. WWDC 2026 kicks off June 8 — all systems glow. We're excited to share what's next across iOS 27, macOS, and the future of Siri.

posts.text: Useful AI has arrived. The PC is being reinvented — for 40 years, you launched apps. With RTX Spark and Microsoft Windows, you ask and the PC does the work. This reinvention is as big as the smartphone. And Marvell — that's why you're going to be the next trillion-dollar company.
posts.caption: Useful AI has arrived. The PC is being reinvented — for 40 years, you launched apps. With RTX Spark and Microsoft Windows, you ask and the PC does the work. This reinvention is as big as the smartphone. And Marvell — that's why you're going to be the next trillion-dollar company.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, ONDC — is proving that population-scale technology can be built as a public good. The next frontier is AI-powered governance and financial inclusion for a billion people.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, ONDC — is proving that population-scale technology can be built as a public good. The next frontier is AI-powered governance and financial inclusion for a billion people.

posts.text: AI is going to be the most transformative tool for global health in my lifetime. We're seeing breakthroughs in drug discovery, diagnostics, and health system optimization that could save millions of lives in the developing world.
posts.caption: AI is going to be the most transformative tool for global health in my lifetime. We're seeing breakthroughs in drug discovery, diagnostics, and health system optimization that could save millions of lives in the developing world.

posts.text: Enterprise AI is no longer experimental — it's operational. IBM is helping the world's largest companies deploy AI at scale with trust, transparency, and governance built in from the start.
posts.caption: Enterprise AI is no longer experimental — it's operational. IBM is helping the world's largest companies deploy AI at scale with trust, transparency, and governance built in from the start.

posts.text: Adobe is re-architecting Photoshop and Premiere for the AI era. Creative tools powered by AI are unlocking possibilities that were unimaginable even two years ago — empowering every creator to do more.
posts.caption: Adobe is re-architecting Photoshop and Premiere for the AI era. Creative tools powered by AI are unlocking possibilities that were unimaginable even two years ago — empowering every creator to do more.

posts.text: Building in AI requires deep technical conviction and the humility to iterate fast. The companies that win will be the ones solving real problems, not chasing hype cycles.
posts.caption: Building in AI requires deep technical conviction and the humility to iterate fast. The companies that win will be the ones solving real problems, not chasing hype cycles.

posts.text: At Chanel, we believe luxury and innovation go hand in hand. Leading a global brand means constantly evolving while staying true to timeless values. Proud of what our teams are building.
posts.caption: At Chanel, we believe luxury and innovation go hand in hand. Leading a global brand means constantly evolving while staying true to timeless values. Proud of what our teams are building.

posts.text: FedEx is leveraging AI and data to transform global logistics. From autonomous delivery to predictive supply chain optimization — we're building the intelligent logistics network of the future.
posts.caption: FedEx is leveraging AI and data to transform global logistics. From autonomous delivery to predictive supply chain optimization — we're building the intelligent logistics network of the future.

posts.text: We asked ourselves a question last year — can we go back to back? Here we are again. 🏆 You walk to practice and you have six cameras following you. As a sportsperson, you need the freedom to work on your game in peace.
posts.caption: We asked ourselves a question last year — can we go back to back? Here we are again. 🏆 You walk to practice and you have six cameras following you. As a sportsperson, you need the freedom to work on your game in peace.

posts.text: I am not going to retire from this format, just to make sure no rumours are spread. Right now, I am taking things as they come. I am enjoying my cricket and the time I spend with this team. That's all that matters.
posts.caption: I am not going to retire from this format, just to make sure no rumours are spread. Right now, I am taking things as they come. I am enjoying my cricket and the time I spend with this team. That's all that matters.

posts.text: Cricket has given me everything. The love from fans, even after stepping away from international cricket, is something I'll always cherish. Watching the next generation of Indian cricketers makes me proud.
posts.caption: Cricket has given me everything. The love from fans, even after stepping away from international cricket, is something I'll always cherish. Watching the next generation of Indian cricketers makes me proud.

posts.text: Fitness and preparation are everything. Working hard in the off-season to come back stronger. The goal is always the same — give my best for India every time I step on the field.
posts.caption: Fitness and preparation are everything. Working hard in the off-season to come back stronger. The goal is always the same — give my best for India every time I step on the field.

posts.text: Every season brings new challenges and new learnings. The IPL has been an incredible journey. Time to regroup, recover, and come back even stronger for what's next.
posts.caption: Every season brings new challenges and new learnings. The IPL has been an incredible journey. Time to regroup, recover, and come back even stronger for what's next.

posts.text: What an incredible IPL season. Vaibhav Suryavanshi's record-breaking 72 sixes at 15 years old is extraordinary — the future of Indian cricket is in safe hands. Congratulations to RCB on back-to-back titles!
posts.caption: What an incredible IPL season. Vaibhav Suryavanshi's record-breaking 72 sixes at 15 years old is extraordinary — the future of Indian cricket is in safe hands. Congratulations to RCB on back-to-back titles!

posts.text: Indian cricket continues to produce extraordinary talent. The IPL 2026 season showcased the best of what this generation can offer. Proud to see the game growing stronger every year.
posts.caption: Indian cricket continues to produce extraordinary talent. The IPL 2026 season showcased the best of what this generation can offer. Proud to see the game growing stronger every year.

posts.text: IPL 2026 wrapped up with a thrilling final as RCB defended their title. What a season of record-breaking performances! India's upcoming schedule: ODI series against Afghanistan and preparation for the Champions Trophy cycle.
posts.caption: IPL 2026 wrapped up with a thrilling final as RCB defended their title. What a season of record-breaking performances! India's upcoming schedule: ODI series against Afghanistan and preparation for the Champions Trophy cycle.

posts.text: What a Champions Trophy it was! Rohit Sharma's India lifted the trophy in Dubai. Cricket continues to unite nations and inspire billions. The road to the 2027 World Cup begins now.
posts.caption: What a Champions Trophy it was! Rohit Sharma's India lifted the trophy in Dubai. Cricket continues to unite nations and inspire billions. The road to the 2027 World Cup begins now.

posts.text: What a season! 🏏 RCB are back-to-back champions! Virat Kohli's unbeaten 75* in the final, Vaibhav Suryavanshi sweeping 5 individual awards including Orange Cap (776 runs) and 72 sixes — a record for the ages. See you in IPL 2027!
posts.caption: What a season! 🏏 RCB are back-to-back champions! Virat Kohli's unbeaten 75* in the final, Vaibhav Suryavanshi sweeping 5 individual awards including Orange Cap (776 runs) and 72 sixes — a record for the ages. See you in IPL 2027!

posts.text: New chapter, fresh start. Parted ways with coach Jan Zelezny after a season of learning. Now fully focused on the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya and Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. The 90-metre mark is the target.
posts.caption: New chapter, fresh start. Parted ways with coach Jan Zelezny after a season of learning. Now fully focused on the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya and Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. The 90-metre mark is the target.

posts.text: Training hard and staying focused ahead of the 2026 season. Every match is a new opportunity to push my limits. The journey to the top never stops — grateful for the support always. 🏸
posts.caption: Training hard and staying focused ahead of the 2026 season. Every match is a new opportunity to push my limits. The journey to the top never stops — grateful for the support always. 🏸

posts.text: Life after professional tennis is a new adventure. Mentoring young Indian athletes and working to grow women's sport in the country gives me incredible purpose. The next generation will go even further.
posts.caption: Life after professional tennis is a new adventure. Mentoring young Indian athletes and working to grow women's sport in the country gives me incredible purpose. The next generation will go even further.

posts.text: Norway Chess Round 7 — won the armageddon against Wesley So after a tense classical draw. It's been a rollercoaster tournament but I'm fighting hard in every game. Round 8 tomorrow! ♟️
posts.caption: Norway Chess Round 7 — won the armageddon against Wesley So after a tense classical draw. It's been a rollercoaster tournament but I'm fighting hard in every game. Round 8 tomorrow! ♟️

posts.text: Indian football continues to grow. Proud to see more young players getting opportunities at the international level. The dream of making India a footballing nation is alive — it takes all of us pushing together.
